notes.title: 30-day update patch overview
notes.content:
[code]30-day modification report and summary of each batch of upgrade patches ————


1. Fixed some resolution display errors and screen adaptation issues.

2. Fixed some map size misalignment issues.

3. Fixed an issue with the AKC Super Heavy Ship clone.

4. Fixed an issue where particle effects did not display when the ship was severely damaged.

5. Optimized some map effects.

5. Optimized the effects of the Heat Ray laser hitting targets.

6. Optimized weapon firing sound effects.

7. Optimized interface effects

8. Cancel the three-shot weapon of medium heavy and heavy ships and change it to two-shot (due to balance requirements)

9. Adjusted the color of AKC camp's grenades and missiles to make it easier to distinguish from the other two camps.[/code]

notes.title: Fixed all AI bugs in the game and optimized some art resource effects+modified s
notes.content: Fixed all AI bugs and optimized some art resource effects in the game+modified some controls of the free camera, The initial release experience of the game was not satisfactory, and it also led to the domestic evaluation team not recommending it. This was caused by various factors. At that time, STEAM had a mandatory period to be released before November 30th, because I had mistakenly clicked on the release date and contacted customer service to reschedule it. Customer service told me that I could only have one chance to resend the game, and it must be released before November 30th. If I missed it, there would be no customs clearance traffic given, because of this matter, The game was released without testing due to some bugs that caused it to be rushed.

tags.bug: Fixed all AI bugs and optimized some art resource effects in the game+modified some controls of the free camera
